title: THE PLAYER 2 PARTY ATTRACT STARTS ON A CLEAR SCREEN
why: His order of 2026-10-18: there seem to be a lot of inconsistencies between p1 and p2 games, please coordinate them better. The player 2 window leaves its title for the floor first, and that floor opens the welcome pack of a fresh save while the arcade is still off. The window clear that runs at the start of arcadeEnter comes before it, so the pack stayed open under the player 2 attract and was what showed through the blur, while player 1 showed the Undercroft. The windows are cleared again once the arcade is on.
now: In the party arcade the player 2 screen no longer shows the welcome pack behind the party pages, it shows the Undercroft like player 1.
